sloka: ताराया च अभ्यनुज्ञात त्वरया चा अपि चोदितः ।प्रविवेश महाबाहुः अभ्यंतरम् अरिन्दमः ॥४-३३-६२॥
transliteration: tārāyā ca abhyanujñāta tvarayā cā api coditaḥ ।praviveśa mahābāhuḥ abhyaṁtaram arindamaḥ ॥4-33-62॥

translations.english: Strongarmed Lakshmana, a subduer of enemies, permitted by Tara entered the harem immediately (thinking of the urgency of the task).
